name: Intel Corporation
old_description: Intel is a leading semiconductor company based in California. Designs and manufactures microprocessors, chipsets, memory and FPGA products for computing, communications and data center markets.
about:
Intel Corporation, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, was founded in 1968.

The company designs and manufactures microprocessors, chipsets, memory, and field-programmable gate array (FPGA) products. With a workforce of over 1,000 employees, Intel operates across research, development, and high-volume fabrication to serve computing, communications, and data center markets. Its platform approach engineers performance, graphics, battery life, and connectivity to work as a unified system.

Intel's products are used in computing, data center, Internet of Things (IoT), and automotive applications. Recent collaborations include providing compute platforms for Googlebook devices and serving as the official compute partner for McLaren Racing, illustrating its reach into consumer electronics and high-performance motorsports. The company also targets AI-ready networking and 5G core infrastructure with its Xeon 6 processor line.

Intel states that it "breaks barriers so builders can move faster, from prototype to global scale," and emphasizes its investment in U.S. manufacturing and AI readiness to strengthen global competitiveness.
